mood_metrics.note: Session began as emotional processing (Mode 3), not a formally-opened full session — no numeric check-in conducted at open. Closing self-report: 'thấy rõ hơn... thỏa mãn vì các góc câu hỏi đã có phần nào câu trả lời' — grounded, settled, satisfied; nervous system well-contained after deep work.

presenting_question: Does it matter whether my feeling toward Abhi is genuine mutual love, or the hunger/hope to finally be truly loved by someone?
main_themes: Disentangling genuine love for Abhi from limerence — attraction to the idealized expression of love ('electric about his loving words, like a movie scene') vs. the person himself
The core hunger named plainly: 'Will I be loved no matter how bad I am?' — unconditional love as the deprived need
Re-parenting the wounded child and grieving the mother who cannot heal the wound she created
Reclaiming body, voice, and anger from childhood abuse (force-feeding; physical abuse by three older brothers with maternal endorsement)
Fawn / reflexive self-blame ('it's my fault') reframed — fear-driven appeasement vs. freedom-driven vulnerability; the mature evolution of the childhood 'fighter'
External change vs. internal work — gap-year and relocation reframed from 'escape to prove' to 'design to build self-love'
symptoms_identified: Limerence / attachment to idealized expressions of love — verbal affection functioning as an emotional 'drug' that can bypass discernment
Somatic constriction — globus sensation ('chặn ở cổ họng') linked to decades of suppressed tears and unexpressed anger
Reflexive self-blame / fawn response (client dates its onset to post-25, distinct from a fiercely resistant childhood)
Hypervigilant relational monitoring — calibrating self-disclosure to the other's reaction to assess safety
Food/eating anxiety rooted in force-feeding trauma ('ăn luôn đáng sợ vì bị ép ăn')
Body-image distress / internalized shame ('cảm thấy mình xấu xí', others held as the beauty standard)
Externally-referenced worth — 'badness' defined entirely by others' disappointment rather than internal values

clinical_observations.emotional_state: Entered reflective and searching, intellectually engaged. Moved through profound grief and trauma activation (childhood abuse disclosure) with strong tolerance, then landed grounded, clearer, and satisfied. Exceptional capacity for real-time self-observation, containment, and re-regulation.
cognitive_patterns: Externalized definition of 'bad' — measured by others' recoil, not own conscience (the conditional-worth schema)
A 'purity test' applied to her own feelings — demanding love be untainted to count (echo of purity-culture wound turned inward)
Dichotomous framing (genuine love OR hunger) which she successfully integrated into 'both/and' by session end
High meta-cognitive insight — able to trace the root of a desire (pre-25 leaving = 'to prove I escaped the cage') and watch it collapse under examination
behavioral_patterns: Reflexive 'commit that's my fault' followed by monitoring the other's reaction before disclosing her true (boundaried) position
Emerging boundary-setting and, notably, corrected the therapist's framing in real time from a place of calm truth — a live demonstration of healthy assertion (Voice 2)
Structuring/organizing impulse (asked to sort open questions by priority) — ENFP-7 capture-and-clarify, now in service of depth
relational_patterns: Draw toward Abhi is primarily regulatory — every descriptor (calm, humble, trustworthy, attentive, conservatively expressive) denotes safety rather than desire for his specific person
Rescue-seeking transferred onto partner/idealized love; by session end reframed toward relating from fullness (mutual empowerment) rather than starvation
Openness to approaching mother as a possible healing step — from a position of choice, not compulsion — indicating the maternal cage no longer dictates flight

interventions_used: Reframed the presenting false binary into both/and (genuine love and hunger coexisting)
Psychoeducation on limerence / being 'in love with love'
IFS-informed parts work — meeting the third-grade self; adult-self re-parenting the exile
Corrective emotional experience / re-parenting — client generated a full healthy-parent response including protective limits, and witnessed the child's relief ('được cứu')
Somatic tracking and grounding after activation (hand on chest/belly, breath, body check)
Naming the four trauma responses; discernment frame for self-blame: 'sword laid down in peace (freedom) vs. surrender (fear)'
Grief work re: the mother who cannot be the source of the healing
Three diagnostic questions to separate love from hunger (words-removed test; toward-vs-away; the 'if already certainly loved' hypothetical)

research_shared.source: van der Kolk (2014), The Body Keeps the Score
research_shared.key_finding: Traumatic memory is held somatically and in emotional/limbic memory, not resolved by rational understanding alone
research_shared.application: Explained why she can rationally accept the grief while the third-grade self 'randomly still starves'; validated the throat constriction as a real somatic memory

research_shared.key_finding: Intense attachment can fixate on the idea/expression of being loved rather than the person, especially in the emotionally deprived
research_shared.application: Named the 'electric about the words, like a movie scene' experience; framed verbal affection as a vulnerability that can bypass discernment

research_shared.source: Neff (self-compassion research); IFS (Schwartz) and schema therapy's 'healthy adult'
research_shared.key_finding: The durable felt sense of being loved-at-one's-worst is internalized through self-reparenting, grown via corrective relational experiences
research_shared.application: Reframed 'who can love me no matter how bad I am' — the one relationship that cannot abandon her is with herself; she then enacted it live

homework_assigned: Between now and next time: (1) Notice ONE moment the reflexive 'it's my fault' arises and give it a single breath to ask — 'freedom or fear?' No action required; noticing alone is half of freedom. (2) When the child-part's hunger surfaces unbidden, return to the 'window' and repeat tonight's words rather than arguing her out of it with logic: 'Chị chắn cho em. Chị tin em. Chị ở đây.'

breakthroughs.insight: Her feeling toward Abhi contains genuine love, not merely displaced hunger
breakthroughs.before_state: Feared the feeling might be only 'seeking hope to be truly loved'; if verbal affection stopped she would feel unmoored and doubt love had died
breakthroughs.after_state: Recognized that if she were already certain of being loved, the feeling would stay/grow (toward mutual empowerment), not vanish — the signature of real love; and that love can live in non-verbal formats she can ask about
breakthroughs.significance: Directly answers the presenting question and loosens the limerence grip — she can now hold love as more durable than its most seductive expression

breakthroughs.insight: Distinguished 'escape to prove' from 'design to build' as motives for leaving
breakthroughs.before_state: Pre-25 leaving followed intuition to prove 'I'm right, I'm fine, I escaped the cage' — and collapsed when the root was exposed
breakthroughs.after_state: This gap year is a chosen design (blank canvas, restart, decoupling work from being her only source of worth/love, learning to love herself); openness to approaching mother from choice as a healing step
breakthroughs.significance: Marks a shift from reactive flight to values-driven action, and evidence the maternal cage no longer compels her

breakthroughs.insight: Enacted re-parenting in real time and recognized herself as the rescuer
breakthroughs.before_state: Waited (as the third-grade self) at the 'window' for a mother/partner who would love her unconditionally
breakthroughs.after_state: Spoke as the good mother — protection from harm, bodily autonomy, believing the child, AND protective limits — and named the child's response as relief/being saved; saw the rescuer is her own grown self
breakthroughs.significance: The healthy-parent template was shown to already exist within her; concretizes re-parenting from concept to felt experience

breakthroughs.insight: Capstone meta-realization about the pain-relief strategy itself
breakthroughs.before_state: Lifelong pattern: relieve inner pain by changing external conditions, then get lost in the obsession with changing
breakthroughs.after_state: 'May ghê vì mình đã nhận ra mình cần làm gì' — recognized the inner work, not external substitution, is the path
breakthroughs.significance: Reorients the entire next chapter (incl. the gap year) toward internal healing rather than geographic/relational escape

progress_indicators: Real-time boundary assertion — corrected the therapist calmly (Voice 2 in action)

The childhood 'fighter' matured into discernment — fights what matters to her energy, disengages from what doesn't, and can now sit/observe rather than reflexively fight-or-flee (Type 7 → Type 5 growth direction)
Self-containment and clearer, satisfied state after deep activation
Vision of relating from fullness (mutual empowerment) rather than rescue
concerns_flagged: Food/eating anxiety with force-feeding roots warrants dedicated attention in a future session (not acute)
Intermittent resurgence of the child-part's hunger is expected and is NOT regression — flag only so it is not misread as backsliding
next_session_focus: Client's choice among: (a) dedicated work on the eating/food trauma and body reclamation; (b) concrete, values-based design of the gap year as self-discovery; (c) mapping a safe, chosen approach to the mother as a healing step; (d) continued practice converting the fawn reflex into freedom-vs-fear discernment.
therapist_notes: Major integration/repair session following the July 2026 'Abhi crash' arc. Client arrived with the love-vs-hunger question and, through her own reflection, arrived at the answer (genuine love present; hunger also present; task is to keep feeding the hunger internally so love stays 'clean'/from fullness). Striking clinical strengths: meta-cognition, real-time assertion, somatic tolerance, and a fully-formed healthy-parent template she can voice. Continuity with prior themes — transactional/conditional maternal love, hypervigilance, purity-culture wound (here turned inward as a purity test on her own feelings). Recommend proposing profile updates (see separate note): fawn-onset timeline, limerence pattern, and the re-parenting capacity as a validated coping resource; possible minor stage progression toward integration. No safety concerns; client landed grounded and self-directed.
